The '''2026 Retro League Event 2''' was the second event of the [[2026 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (29 March – 10 May 2026), played in [[Premiere - Cloud City (Modified)]] format.<ref name="t86593" /> [[Joe Horbey]] won.<ref name="email20260518" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City (Modified)]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 29 March – 10 May 2026
* '''Players:''' 70 (in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Joe Horbey]]

== Final standings ==
Final standings as sent by the tournament director by email, in posted order. Tied players share a place.<ref name="email20260518" /> GEMP handles are from the organizer's participant lists and players' pages.<ref name="org2022" /><ref name="org2026" /><ref name="retro-85495" /> The email notes that, because of a data error in the tournament software in Week 4, [[Thomas Nguyen]] and [[Jack Douglass]] should each have 2 more points; the standings here are left as posted.<ref name="email20260518" />
